description: Day packet — one a day, filed in Reports by the agent that assembles it, for its person's daily sitting. Four parts, always in this order: yesterday's outcomes, each naming its source; the decisions needed, each with two to four choices, the recommended one first, and a default; tomorrow's plan, each item at its level and naming the request that approves it; and the risks, each with what will be done if it happens. It approves nothing: each approval stays on its own request, decided by whoever holds update on it.

source.description: The id of the artifact it is read from: a Pipeline artifact, a Backlog item or a release record.

outcomes.description: Yesterday's outcomes: what shipped, what failed, what changed in the plan, each naming its source.

default.description: One of the choices: taken when the decision is not answered by its level's time.

source.description: The id of the artifact that asks it.

decisions.description: The decisions needed, each asked once.

level.description: The id of the approval-level artifact the item is approved at.

request.description: The id of the request that approves it, when it needs one.

plan.description: Tomorrow's plan: what each agent will do, each item at its level and naming its request.

response.description: What will be done if it happens.

risks.description: What could go wrong tomorrow, and what will be done if it does.
